assertions.claim: Five official Paramount episode listing dates are one calendar day later than the matching individual episode-detail header dates. The publisher has not established their timezone or date semantics here; neither display is promoted to verified broadcast date.
assertions.falsifier: Publisher documentation of date field semantics, timezone and edition, with authenticated raw page/capture evidence, could reconcile the displays.

assertions.claim: Within the same Paramount Season 7 listing, Episode 16 has a displayed February 15, 1999 date earlier than Episode 15's February 22, 1999 date. This observation does not determine airing order or establish an error.
assertions.falsifier: An authenticated edition-specific schedule or publisher data dictionary could explain whether listing order and displayed dates are intended to be monotonic.
